log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY (set day1): Kill national + regional:East + podcasts + forum + foreign. NEVER kill gazette-only criminals. That gives about 9 kills a day and 4x from day 5 (need 40 or more deaths in the last 5 days). A gazette criminal is OK only if he is also listed in national or in one of the 4 allowed places. Reasoning: L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds. If he learns 3 kinds the pool is 55k/64 = 859 and I am caught. If he learns only 2 kinds the pool is about 3,400, which is safe. Excluding sector (20%) is safe if sector is reachable (60% chance). Routine: put ALL quick kills in the AFTERNOON and never more than 2 in the morning. That keeps students, home and night workers (55%), so the expected pool is about 55,000 at first. Use timed entries only if more than 10 quick kills are needed, also in the afternoon. Press conference guide: about 55k means nothing learned; about 10-14k means 1 kind learned; about 3k means 2 kinds learned (expected end state); 20-30k means union constraints. If the pool reads 2,000 or less, something is off: reconsider cutting to fewer kinds (e.g. only national + forum + foreign). Day1: killed 9 (all except the 2 gazette criminals), afternoon quick.
